program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.5, 1.5, 3.5),        # input pair L (flicker area)
    "Itail": (46e-6, 36e-6, 52e-6),  # tail current
    "L3":    (1.5, 0.8, 2.5),        # PMOS mirror-load L
    "gmid6": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # output PMOS gm/Id
    "L6":    (0.8, 0.4, 1.5),        # output PMOS L
    "I6":    (140e-6, 110e-6, 150e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.6e-12, 1.0e-12, 2.2e-12),
    "kz":    (1.0, 0.6, 1.8),        # Rz = kz*(1+CL/Cc)/gm6
    "LN":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS bias/tail/sink L
    "gmidN": (14.0, 10.0, 17.0),     # NMOS bias/tail/sink gm/Id (tail headroom)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Cc = p["Cc"]
    It = p["Itail"]
    I6 = p["I6"]
    gmidN = p["gmidN"]
    LN = p["LN"]

    mb = lut.size("n", gmidN, LN, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidN, LN, It, vds=0.2)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidN, LN, I6, vds=0.9)

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L3"], It / 2, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["kz"] * (1.0 + CL / Cc) / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "xz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "xz", "vout", Cc)

    A1 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    wu = m1.gm / Cc
    ugbw = 0.91 * wu / (2 * PI)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (C1 * CL + Cc * (C1 + CL))
    dz = Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm
    p3 = 1.0 / (Rz * C1)
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3))
    if dz > 0:
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(wu * Cc * dz))
    elif dz < 0:
        pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(wu * Cc * -dz))
    pm += 4.0
    slew = 0.68 * min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)
    swing = 1.8 - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat + 0.1
    cmrr_db = db(2 * m1.gm * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12) / max(m3.gm, 1e-12)) - 10.0
    # PSRR(VDD) limited by output-stage and mirror mismatch; empirical offset from sim
    psrr_db = gain_db - 17.0 + 3.0 * (p["gmid1"] - 12.0) / 1.2 * 0.1 * 10 / 10
    therm = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / m1.gm * (1 + m3.gm / m1.gm))
    # flicker: calibrated at gmid1=12, L1=1 -> ~510 nV; scales ~ L^-0.8, gmid^-1.3
    flick = 510e-9 * (p["L1"] / 1.0) ** -0.8 * (p["gmid1"] / 12.0) ** -1.3
    noise = math.sqrt(therm ** 2 + flick ** 2)
    settle = 0.7 * (0.4 / slew + 5.0 / wu)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "noise_1k": noise, "settle": settle}
